text:
Sam: Heads up — PR #33333 is blocked by CI: macOS UI snapshots failed on shard-7 (image diffs). Need quick decision: approve snapshot update, request targeted rerun, or bisect? Merge window is 17:00 PT.
Anya: can you paste the failure link and the diff?
Sam: https://ci.example.com/builds/4321 — look at /ui/button-hover/snapshot.png diff. small shift on the hover state. I rebased and ran tests locally; can't repro.
CI Bot: Build 4321 failed — tests/ui/button-hover (shard-7 macOS) — diff: https://ci.example.com/builds/4321/artifacts/diff.png
Chris: hmm, that looks like a 1px offset on the hover gradient. We've seen similar nondets with animations. Which runner image + chrome version?
Sam: macOS-11 + HeadlessChrome 95 (see job env in link).
Marta: if it's animation timing, snapshot update is risky. I'd prefer a targeted rerun first. If it passes twice, we can consider approving.
Anya: agree with Marta. If rerun fails again then bisect. Can someone kick a targeted rerun for shard-7?
Chris: I can do a targeted rerun. Command I use: `./dev/ci rerun --pr 33333 --shard shard-7 --targeted`.
Sam: started the rerun — queued as build 4322. will post results.
CI Bot: Rerun queued: build 4322 (targeted shard-7).
CI Bot: Build 4322 started (shard-7).
Sam: also adding a tiny log snippet in case it helps: ```
[2026-03-17T15:22:10Z] render: hover-layer z-index applied
[2026-03-17T15:22:10Z] screenshot captured: /tmp/snap.png
```
Chris: thanks — that log lines up with a timing-sensitive paint. If 4322 passes once, let's run it a second time before approving. Two green runs gives me confidence.
CI Bot: Build 4322 passed (shard-7).
Sam: reran a second time (build 4323) — queued.
CI Bot: Build 4323 started.
CI Bot: Build 4323 passed.
Marta: two passes — I'm comfortable. @Anya @Chris do you want to review diffs or I can approve and you can follow up if any regression appears? :thumbsup:
Anya: I skimmed the diff — it's strictly visual hover offset, no functional change. I'm fine with approving the snapshot update.
Chris: SGTM. leaving a quick comment on the PR about animation flakiness and a follow-up to add `animation: none` in tests or a `--stable-render` flag.
Sam: thanks all — Marta can you approve then I'll land after the 5-min merge hold?
Marta: approved and added LGTM. :heavy_check_mark:
Sam: merging in 5m. Will monitor post-merge telemetry. If anything spikes I'll revert.
Anya: thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Chris: nice — good process.
CI Bot: PR #33333 merged by Sam (merge commit 7a9c3f).
Sam: merged and monitoring. closing thread.
